# RPS_E research record

**AI disclosure:** This document, including its title and all prose, was generated by AI at the repository owner's request.

This is the research record for
[libva-v4l2_request#38](https://github.com/iconidentify/libva-v4l2_request/issues/38).
It does **not** correct `RPS_E_qualcomm_5`. Implementation belongs to
[libva-v4l2_request#42](https://github.com/iconidentify/libva-v4l2_request/issues/42) (H2).

## First differing pictures

VA-API vs software (output order from `frame-check`): first mismatch is **frame 31**, a B picture. All 26 VA mismatches are B pictures. Indices:

`31, 73-74, 76-95, 117, 123, 221`

Frames 0–30 and 222–299 match software on the VA path, including the last two frames. This is not a truncated or resized output.

Direct V4L2 vs software: first mismatch is **frame 26** (also B). 25 wrong indices:

`26, 28-31, 74, 76-83, 85, 88, 91, 94, 181, 185, 217-218, 220-221, 283`

15 indices fail on both paths. 11 fail only through VA-API. 10 fail only through GStreamer V4L2. Per-frame hashes on the union set are in
`tests/fixtures/rps-e/rps-e-research.json`.

## Layer

1. Corruption happens **without this VA driver**: GStreamer `v4l2slh265dec` still
   mismatches 25 pictures. That path still has GStreamer's HEVC parser and
   DPB/LTR control encoder, so this does **not** prove the kernel/firmware is
   sufficient by itself.
2. The VA driver is **not a transparent pass-through** of the GStreamer failure:
   it produces a third stream MD5 (the r11 userspace baseline) and a different
   26-picture set.
3. r8 decode-order remapping is off here because the SPS sets
   `long_term_ref_pics_present_flag=1` (with `num_long_term_ref_pics_sps=0`).
   Historical unrestricted remapping moved RPS_E from 26 to 30 wrong frames, so
   turning the RPS_B workaround on for LTR-capable SPS is not an acceptable H2.

SPS traces (ffmpeg `trace_headers`): RPS_E
`long_term_ref_pics_present_flag=1`. Sampled slice headers in the first capture
showed `num_long_term_pics=0`. That explains the r8 SPS gate. It is not
command-level proof that long-term POCs were submitted to firmware.

## Hypothesis for H2

VA-API's DPB list (VA order, LTR flags copied from `VAPictureHEVC`) and
GStreamer's V4L2 request controls are two different command encodings of the
same bitstream, so they fail overlapping but not identical B pictures.
Whether firmware is sensitive to long-term POC identity remains a hypothesis
until slice `num_long_term_pics` and DPB LTR flags for frames 26–31 are dumped.

A userspace-only reorder heuristic is the wrong next change. Discriminating
experiment: dump per-request DPB timestamp/POC/LTR-flag/slice-RPS indices for
output frames 26–31 on the VA path (opt-in env trace). Kernel kprobes remain
out of scope without `needs:kernel-approval`. Kernel sufficiency stays unproven
until those request controls are compared.

The VA-path half of that experiment now has its instrument:
`LIBVA_V4L2_HEVC_REFTRACE` records the submitted DPB, RPS lists and slice
reference indices per request, and `tests/hevc-reftrace-check.py` compares two
such traces ([HEVC_REFTRACE.md](HEVC_REFTRACE.md), #84). No hardware capture
has been taken with it yet; the association procedure is documented there and
the conclusions stay with #42.

## H2 contract (do not violate)

- Keep RPS_B at 300/300 on VA-API and direct V4L2.
- Do not match on the filename `RPS_E_qualcomm_5`.
- Do not enable decode-order remapping for SPS with
  `long_term_ref_pics_present_flag`.
- Do not count a new checksum as a pass unless it equals
  `c30d38bbd7ea483dc7ffe81325118e16` with 300 native 416×240 frames.
- Preserve the r11 VA checksum `b09ac8e0bd31a96d8354505d7c2ebdd5` as the
  known-wrong baseline; a change that produces a fourth wrong hash is not
  progress by itself.

## Tests not run

- Full `JCT-VC-HEVC_V1` 147-vector suite (only RPS_B and RPS_E)
- Four-process / Chrome concurrency (#39)
- Kernel traces, module reload, reboot, installation
- Unrestricted VA reorder rerun (already documented as worse)

## Guard note

`tests/hwguard.py` treated `apple_avd: loading out-of-tree module taints kernel.`
as a decoder fault because the marker was the substring `apple_avd`. That line
is not a firmware error; the filter now ignores taint lines so a healthy idle
decoder can be leased.
